summary: Republic Services filed an 8-K to report first-quarter 2026 financial results and declare a regular quarterly dividend of $0.625 per share. The filing includes Items 2.02 (earnings release) and 8.01 (dividend declaration). No M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is described. The dividend is a routine capital return event consistent with prior payments. As this is a standard earnings and dividend announcement, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situations classification.
